description: `action.submit.fields`. Text entry (orders) goes into a slow window (`action.begin`, then `action.submit { window_id }`) or Compose; casts go as instant actions. If neither `left` nor `right` is present (or both are null), `text` is read instead: lines starting `l:`/`left:` go to the left hand, `r:`/`right:` to the right, other lines to the left. Remember the core caps `text` at 500 chars, so put long speech in the fields. The v0 keys `slow`, `sent_at`, `window` (and a `/slow` line) are refused.

anyOf.description: Rules 0.8.1: challenge a rival's demigod in reach to a duel (an instant action that travels alone; forced). Refusals: not_yours, fallen, bad_target, too_far:<distance km>:<allowed km>, busy, cooldown, challenge_disabled.

level.description: The board level it was issued at (missing or unknown = regions): the reach is max(challenge_min_km 120, the touching-cards distance at this level: regions 600, villages 15, houses 0.15, people 0.015 km); it also frames the fight (the lock's cell).

anyOf.description: Rules 0.8.1: one line typed in a duel, resolved at once (`duel.blow`). Refusals: no_duel, duel_over, not_yours, fallen, empty, too_long.

Live typing (instant; travels alone): a duellist's client says how its unsent line stands. Relayed at once to everyone as `duel.typing`; it decides nothing, is not stored and is not replayed to a reconnecting client. Refusals: challenge_disabled, panels_off, no_duel, not_yours, bad_len, bad_tail.

len.description: Characters in the line being typed now.

tail.description: The newest characters typed since your last duel_keys (0 to 8, never more than `len`; empty after a deletion). No control or invisible format characters.

anyOf.description: Rules 0.8.2 (instant; travels alone): a duellist's client says the current panel's input window closed, so the next panel is computed now. Refusals: panels_off, no_duel, not_yours.

left.description: What you say to your left hand this beat (<= 2000 chars). Empty = that hand does nothing (no LLM call). Newlines separate commands.

right.description: What you say to your right hand this beat (<= 2000 chars). Empty = that hand does nothing (no LLM call). Newlines separate commands.

anyOf.description: Rules 0.8.0: summon one of your demigods there, this beat (an instant action, any phase).

target.description: [lon, lat] or a hex cell key.

anyOf.description: Case-insensitive; map/planet/globe = world, region = district, person = character.

focus.description: A ref ("ch:12", any that exists) or the exact name of something visible at district zoom. Unresolvable = no focus (no error).

level.description: Case-insensitive; map/planet/globe = world, region = district, person = character.

zoom.description: Optional view change, applied at the start of Resolve: a level string, or {level, focus}. Null/empty = no change. A level without focus clears your focus.
